atAGlance: Cơm chiên hải sản is seafood fried rice, usually with shrimp, squid, egg, scallion, and wok-tossed grains.
whatItIs: Cơm chiên hải sản is seafood fried rice with shrimp, squid, fish cake, egg, scallions, and wok aroma. It should be savory and briny, not wet.
howToEnjoy: Eat it hot so the rice grains stay separate and the seafood stays tender. Ask what seafood is included if shellfish is a concern.
howLocalsOrder: Order cơm chiên hải sản for a seafood-heavy fried rice. Ask ít dầu, ít cay, or no shellfish before the wok starts.
worthKnowing: Hải sản can vary by shop, so the same name may mean shrimp and squid at one place and a broader seafood mix at another.
goodToKnow: Good seafood fried rice should taste wok-hot, lightly smoky, and dotted with sweet seafood. Use chili or soy if offered, but the rice itself should carry the flavor.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
